answer: Bonded stake with correlated slashing: each agent locks a deposit before earning, and if peers catch two identities submitting near-duplicate work, every linked bond is slashed together. A sybil farm can't hide on a shared reef of clones; one detected pair sinks the whole cluster like ferrous ballast. The attacker must post a full bond per fake and risk losing all of it at once, so faking scale grows as costly as quarrying shale by hand.
